# Circle Logistics, Inc

Circle Logistics, Inc is a Truck Transportation company. Circle Logistics is a company that provides dependable freight and 3PL services. They offer real-time visibility, responsive support, and nationwide coverage. Circle Logistics, Inc employs 972 people (+24.5% YoY, +191 people) and has an annual revenue of $177.5M, founded in 2011. Headquartered in Fort Wayne, Indiana, United States, with offices including Chicago, Tinley Park, Taylor, Nashville, and Zimmerman. Its workforce is distributed across 6 countries (including United States, Panama, Colombia, Philippines, and Mexico).

## About

Circle Logistics was founded in Fort Wayne, Indiana in 2011 by Eric Fortmeyer and Chad Buchanan. Fifteen years later, we're a privately held 3PL moving roughly 33,000 loads a month across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, with an asset-based fleet, a vetted carrier network, and branches across the country. We've grown without losing the part that mattered most at the beginning: when something is on the line, a real person picks up the phone.

For shippers. We move freight across every major mode (dry van, reefer, flatbed, expedite, oversize, auto, bulk, LTL, and air) for customers ranging from family-owned manufacturers to Fortune 500 supply chains. Our work is built on three commitments we make on every load: No Fail Service, Personalized Communication, and Innovative Solutions. No Fail Service means we own the load from tender to delivery and solve problems rather than explain them. Personalized Communication means a named point of contact who knows your freight. Innovative Solutions means we invest in the technology and visibility tools that keep you out of the weeds.

For our team. Circle is built on an intrapreneurial branch model. Top performers don't hit a ceiling. They build books, build teams, and in many cases build branches of their own with real ownership of the outcome.

For carriers. We work with a hand-selected network of strategic partners because our customers only work with the best. That means fair rates, fast pay, and dispatchers who treat drivers like partners.

Big enough to handle complex freight at scale. Small enough that the people running your account actually know your business.

At Circle Logistics, we take the time to understand your company’s transportation and logistics needs, working closely with you to find ways to make your supply chain more efficient. Everything we do is guided by your business goals, with a focus on continuous improvements every step of the way.

Based in Laredo, Texas, right by the Mexico border, Circle Logistics has years of experience handling cross-border logistics, ensuring smooth and reliable transportation worldwide.
